first_page: Models page /ai-models/ for curious people who want to see and try AI models. First: browse trending Hub models by task (public API, keyless) with their card summary and licence, try one small text or image model right in the browser with Transformers.js (nothing sent), and a section on the models Verse itself runs (lib/models.js). Will not build: hosting, training, inference APIs, datasets uploads or accounts.
